claim.text: The hazard onset was classified as closing, indicating the struck vehicle closed within the ego lane.
Perception took 1.1023 s from hazard onset to first detection, above the 0.3 s perception threshold.
Command took 0.0751 s from first detection to brake request, below the 0.1 s command threshold.
Brake actuation took 0.12 s from CAN brake request to pressure reached, below the 0.25 s actuation threshold.
The brake log was complete, so the brake timing data support a conclusive finding.
With nominal perception 0.2 s, nominal command 0.05 s, and nominal brake tau 0.15 s, the counterfactual produced no contact and a minimum gap of 5.7666 m.
The video witness reported daylight, and an independent recheck of the hazard window also reported daylight.
Perception delay is the primary contributing factor: it exceeded its threshold while command and actuation did not, and nominal timing avoided contact.
